items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...see if he had, Langley. [INTERVIEWEE] Mm-hmm. 6440 Langley.

ctx.x: That's the first thing. He has an address, but he doesn't have a telephone number.
Mm-hmm. All right, I'll wrap him a note. Tell him that I talked with you. And, and I wish he'd call me and see if he had, Langley.
